name: 3D Arena — pointer lock
description: S0/S2/S8: Three.js FPS must persist engine=three, acquire pointer lock, and not ship Phaser HTML.
brief: Make a first-person 3D arena shooter. Click to lock the pointer, WASD to move on the camera basis, mouse to look. Enemies spawn in waves. Use createFpsController. Include WebAudio hit SFX.
